Hi! I'm Vikasini Senthilkumar. 
I grew up in Qatar and completed my bachelor's degree in Computing Science at the University of Alberta. 
I am currently pursuing my Master of Data Science at UBC, where I hope to strengthen my skills in data science and machine learning. 
I'm excited to apply what I learn to real-world problems and continue building my career in the field.
